MATCH (i:Issue)-[:IN_PROJECT]->(pr:Project)
OPTIONAL MATCH (i)-[:ASSIGNED_TO|REPORTED_BY|CREATED_BY]->(p:Person)
WITH i,pr,collect(DISTINCT p.personKey) AS a
OPTIONAL MATCH (q:Person)-[t:LOGGED_TIME]->(i) WHERE t.seconds>0
WITH i,pr,a,collect(DISTINCT q.personKey) AS b, collect(DISTINCT t.historyId) AS tids
WITH i,pr,tids,[x IN a+b WHERE x IS NOT NULL] AS ps
UNWIND ps AS k
WITH i,pr,tids,collect(DISTINCT k) AS people
WHERE size(people)>=2
RETURN i.issueKey AS issue, pr.projectKey AS project, people, tids

MATCH (i:Issue)-[:IN_PROJECT]->(pr:Project)
OPTIONAL MATCH (i)-[:ASSIGNED_TO|REPORTED_BY|CREATED_BY]->(p:Person)
WITH i,pr,collect(DISTINCT p.personKey) AS a
OPTIONAL MATCH (q:Person)-[t:LOGGED_TIME]->(i) WHERE t.seconds>0
WITH i,pr,a,collect(DISTINCT q.personKey) AS b
WITH i,pr,[x IN a+b WHERE x IS NOT NULL] AS ps
UNWIND ps AS k
WITH i,pr,collect(DISTINCT k) AS people WHERE size(people)>=2
WITH collect(i) AS iss, collect(DISTINCT pr.projectKey) AS prj, collect(people) AS pl
RETURN [x IN apoc.coll.toSet(apoc.coll.flatten(pl)) | x] AS people, prj

MATCH (i:Issue)-[:IN_PROJECT]->(pr:Project)
OPTIONAL MATCH (i)-[:ASSIGNED_TO|REPORTED_BY|CREATED_BY]->(p:Person)
WITH i,pr,collect(DISTINCT p.personKey) AS a
OPTIONAL MATCH (q:Person)-[t:LOGGED_TIME]->(i) WHERE t.seconds>0
WITH i,pr,a,collect(DISTINCT q.personKey) AS b
WITH i,pr,[x IN a+b WHERE x IS NOT NULL] AS ps
UNWIND ps AS k
WITH i,pr,collect(DISTINCT k) AS people WHERE size(people)>=2
WITH collect({i:i.issueKey,p:pr.projectKey,ps:people}) AS rows
UNWIND rows AS r
UNWIND r.ps AS id
RETURN DISTINCT id, 'person' AS kind
